verdict: Source-proven focus-read feedback repair accepted locally; installed-app performance/lock acceptance remains pending.

runtimeTrigger.finding: Verified Android artifact recorded 280 profile RPCs, 279 memory-album RPCs, a 31,482.659ms outer auth lock hold and eight five-second lock warnings. Sampled timer identities stayed stable.

sourceMechanism.finding: The actual successful load merges profile data through setAuthProfile. AppNavigator subscribes to that store profile and rerenders.

sourceMechanism.source: src/navigation/AppNavigator.tsx, both NavigationContainer branches in published baseline
sourceMechanism.finding: An inline onUnhandledAction function was newly allocated on each render, including profile-only refreshes.
The callback is provided in UnhandledActionContext and included in the navigation helpers memo dependency list.

Per-screen navigation cache depends on the helper object and the focus effect depends on navigation. Changed callback identity therefore restarts a focused screen effect even without a real focus transition.
Both Profile loading and memory-album refreshing are focus effects, consistent with their nearly equal repeated request counts.

REST fetch obtains the access token/session before checking an explicit Authorization header. Auth calls queue while lockAcquired and the outer lock drains pendingInLock until empty, so ongoing focus reads can prolong one outer lock. Per-read runtime queue attribution is inferred from these pinned sources and the retained trace, not directly logged.

change.description: Hoist the existing stateless unhandled-action body to one module-level function and pass the same function to both normal and recovery NavigationContainers.
unchangedBehavior: GO_BACK remains ignored. Other actions log only the optional action type with the existing prefix.
The handler captures no account, profile, theme or lifecycle state.
Session revision subscription, root account/session key, recovery/setup gates, routes, providers and real blur/refocus behavior remain unchanged.
No auth SDK, lock deadline, timer, storage, retry, capability or CI setting was changed by this repair.
change.productionDiff: One function/comment addition and two inline-prop replacements only.

testSemantics: Actual AppNavigator TSX provides the callback and root key. Installed Navigation helper/cache/focus hooks and real StackRouter execute.

Actual ProfileScreen load callback is extracted via TypeScript AST and executed with a bounded successful synthetic RPC/auth-store host. The baseline produces seven reads across the initial focus plus six publication turns; fixed source produces one.
Separate cases cover normal/recovery handler identity, real blur/refocus with duplicate-focus suppression, GO_BACK/type-only diagnostic behavior, and A-to-B-to-A root key distinction.

sourceProvenanceLimit: Installed SDK version and recorded SDK provenance are consistent with the verified native manifest; local Navigation hooks are pinned by package lock. Local source hashes do not independently attest each final Metro bundle instruction.
limits: React scheduling, native hosts, auth state and contexts/listeners are controlled doubles. This focused harness is not a fully mounted native application.
Six deterministic settled render turns demonstrate feedback, not production throughput or latency.
The A-to-B-to-A case proves preservation of the actual root session key; it does not itself prove native destruction/provider reset.

This repair removes one concrete request feedback path. A subsequent installed-app artifact must show actual profile/shelf request counts and lock timing; no warning suppression or deadline relaxation is permitted.
Other agents own the independently evidenced shelf-centering and native media repairs. Their source/tests are outside this focused result.
